The '''CR-17 Incendia''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] built by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[CR-17 Incendia III|third model]] of the vehicle was released. The [[Zalpertine Cup/Legends|Zalpertine Cup]] was a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] series on [[Korrilan IV/Legends|Korrilan IV]] that strictly catered to the Incendia model racer.<ref name="EV" />

==Description==
The CR-17 Incendia Podracers were extremely fast, while incorporating safety features and cosmetic modifications. While other Podracers were built to demonstrate advanced technology or trick fabrication, the CR-17s were better used to demonstrate piloting skill.<ref name="EV" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The CR-17 Incendia was first introduced in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in update 1.6.3 and available to purchase in the Cartel Market.<ref name="TOR">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.6.3/1232013|text=Game Update 1.6.3 Patch Notes}}</ref>
